rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking or singing in a pleasingly poetic way.

example.english: They sing so lyrically that we are completely captivated.
example.traditional: 佢唱歌唱得好有詩意咁，聽到我哋都入晒迷。
example.jyutping: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dak1 hou2 jau5 si1 ji3 gam3 teng1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 dou1 jap6 saai3 mai4

rows.note: Use this when judging or describing a song specifically in terms of its lyrics.

example.english: This song is lyrically excellent, and every line resonates.
example.traditional: 呢首歌喺歌詞方面寫得好出色，句句都好有共鳴。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 hai2 go1 ci4 fong1 min6 se2 dak1 hou2 ceot1 sik1 geoi3 geoi3 dou1 hou2 jau5 gung6 ming4
